title: Homemade Ukrainian Dumplings
description: A traditional Ukrainian recipe featuring homemade dumplings filled with a dense, chewy dough.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine the warm water, yeast, and 1 teaspoon of sugar. Let it sit for 5 minutes until the yeast is activated.
2. Add the all-purpose flour, salt, crumbled bread, eggs, milk, and mix until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
4. Divide the dough into small pieces and roll each one into a ball.
5. Use a rolling pin to flatten each ball into a thin circle.
6. Place a small spoonful of filling in the center of each circle.
7. Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
8. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and gently add the dumplings.
9. Cook the dumplings for 10-15 minutes until they float to the surface.
10. Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite toppings.
